module.capability: Search public building records and inspect hash-bound local architectural references to characterize evidence gaps.
input_contract: Allow-listed public sources and local project artifacts.
output_contract: Append-only attempt JSON with source IDs, located observations, per-gap outcomes and stop reason.
evidence_contract: Non-unknown claims cite an existing source ID and precise page, section, view or media timestamp.
Unknowns and retrieval failures remain explicit.
allowed_actions: Read public government and news pages.
Inspect local references and media metadata/frames.
Record findings in this building job.
forbidden_actions: Promote user-reported values to independently verified facts.
Modify or replace the delivered video.
Call external model providers or reveal credentials.
side_effects: Updated this job sources, discovery plan and append-only attempt/index only.
module.data_retention: Stored locally in the building job; source republication permission remains UNKNOWN.

lifecycle.upgrade: Create a new module version and a new attempt.
lifecycle.rollback: Select an earlier indexed attempt without deleting this record.
lifecycle.replacement: Register a replacement module identity and rerun against current bindings.
lifecycle.revocation: Stop selecting this module and mark subsequent attempts NOT_RUN.

limitations: Yuncheng pages timed out on direct open; only search excerpts were observed.
Only sampled video frames were compared; no full component-motion, lighting or pacing audit was performed.
No survey geometry or structural drawing was located in this bounded run.

queries.query: site:yuncheng.gov.cn 鹳雀楼 月台83m 总高度主楼高度顶层间数
queries.result: Search excerpt reports main height 57.4 m, total 73.9 m, platform footprint 83 x 72 m and top 5 x 3 bays; it omits platform vertical height and lower 7 x 5 grid. Direct open timed out.

queries.query: site:yuncheng.gov.cn/doc/2025/04/10/517584.shtml 鹳雀楼 台基三层 楼身六层 总高73.9
queries.result: Search excerpt attributed to Yuncheng Daily states platform three levels, body six levels, total height 73.9 m and rebuilding/opening in 2002.

queries.query: Inspect current user-provided view inventory for distinct sightlines.
queries.result: Two front-oblique images (wide and close) are registered; neither is a rear or orthographic elevation.

queries.query: Compare the government form description with the current R3 photo-audit notes.
queries.result: Government excerpt reports four eaves, three exterior storeys and a concrete skeleton; R3 contains photo-derived observations but no survey drawing.

queries.query: Decode the pinned upstream demo at 0, 5, 10 and 15 seconds and inspect component progression.
queries.result: H.264 1280x740, 120 fps, 19.575 s; sampled frames show progression from base/lower frame toward a complete multi-storey tower.

queries.query: Decode the delivered Guanque MP4 at 0, 6, 12 and 18 seconds and compare with its shot plan.
queries.result: H.264 1080x1920, 30 fps, 24 s; frames and shot plan show complete-building opening, reverse disassembly, forward assembly and finished close.

queries.query: site:yuncheng.gov.cn 鹳雀楼 重建 钢筋水泥骨架 结构
queries.result: Government excerpts report reinforced-cement/concrete skeleton; opened Xinhua-attributed 2002 report says reinforced-concrete-frame structure. No source specifies shear-wall layout.

queries.query: Inventory referenced elevations, interiors and hidden structure in the current source package.
queries.result: Only two front-oblique exteriors are registered; no rear/side elevations, interior plans or concealed-structure drawings are registered.

observations.locator: Main Building section in search excerpt; direct page fetch timed out.

observations.locator: 2025-04-10 article search excerpt; direct page fetch timed out.

observations.statement: The 16.5 m platform height and lower 7 x 5 bay grid remain user-reported; located government excerpts do not state either explicitly.

observations.statement: The current visitor building is the rebuilt Tang-style structure completed/opened in 2002, not the lost historical tower.
observations.locator: Opened page lines 7-16; report and photograph attributed to Xinhua.

observations.statement: Registered user references show two front-oblique views, one wide and one closer.
No rear or orthographic side elevation is present in the current source package.
observations.locator: Only front-oblique-wide and front-oblique-detail are registered.

observations.statement: Public description reports four eaves, three exterior storeys, top 5 x 3 bays, surrounding corridors and four projecting gable-roofed bays.
observations.locator: Main Building section in search excerpt; direct fetch timed out.

observations.statement: R3 records eave-slope and roof-intersection observations from two photos and says those pixel ratios are not surveyed geometry.
observations.locator: docs/photo-comparison-r3.md sections “原图图谱” and “仍不能宣称相同的部分”.

observations.statement: Detailed orthographic roof joints, hidden intersections and complete bracket geometry lack supporting drawings or detail views.
observations.locator: Current source package has two front-oblique images and no survey drawings.

observations.statement: Pinned demo progresses from base/lower frame toward a complete multi-storey building in sampled frames.
observations.locator: Decoded timestamps 00:00, 00:05, 00:10 and 00:15 from the SHA-bound local video.

observations.statement: Pilot opens on the completed building, reverses/disassembles, then rebuilds forward; this differs from the demo ground-up growth.
observations.locator: Decoded timestamps 00:00, 00:06, 00:12 and 00:18; cross-checked against pipeline/video/guanque-pilot-wide.json.

observations.statement: Upstream preview is 19.575 s at 1280x740 and 120 fps; pilot is 24 s at 1080x1920 and 30 fps.
observations.locator: ffprobe on both hash-bound videos; pilot spec cross-referenced to prior-guanque-video.

observations.statement: Government and Xinhua-attributed public reports describe a reinforced-cement/concrete frame or skeleton.
Specific shear-wall arrangement in user notes was not located in inspected public sources.
observations.locator: docs/user-reference.md limits section; original structural pages are absent.

observations.statement: Source register covers two front-oblique exteriors and no interior plans.
Rear/side details, internal floor plans and concealed structure remain unknown.
observations.locator: No corresponding view or drawing is registered.

outcomes.summary: Government excerpts corroborate main/total heights, platform footprint, top-level bays and three-plus-six level descriptions; 16.5 m platform height and lower 7 x 5 bays remain unverified.
limitations: Government pages were visible as search excerpts because direct fetch timed out.
Do not infer the 16.5 m platform height by subtracting the reported main height from total height.

outcomes.summary: The current rebuilt visitor-building identity is supported; visual references remain limited to two front-oblique views.
limitations: No rear or orthographic side view was located.

outcomes.summary: Qualitative form and photo-based observations are recorded, but exact roof-joint and bracket geometry lack authoritative detail drawings.
limitations: R3 pixel ratios are not surveyed dimensions.
Keep hidden intersections and unsupported details UNKNOWN.

outcomes.summary: Major narrative mismatch is confirmed: the demo grows from the base, while the pilot opens complete, reverses, then rebuilds. Full component granularity, motion distance, lighting and pacing remain unreviewed.
limitations: Only four evenly spaced timestamps per clip were sampled.
No quantitative similarity claim is made.

outcomes.summary: Public reports support a reinforced-cement/concrete frame or skeleton, but not the detailed shear-wall arrangement in user notes.
limitations: No structural drawings or shear-wall layout were located.
The visual model does not simulate actual load paths.

outcomes.summary: Only front-oblique exterior coverage is registered; rear/side elevations, interiors and concealed structure remain unknown.
limitations: Do not mirror or invent unseen architectural details.

stop_reason: Within planned budgets, the bounded first pass located public descriptions and confirmed the demo narrative mismatch. Critical view/detail evidence remains partial or unknown; stopped without expanding source scope or declaring discovery complete.
